info.title: SILO API v2 (deployed preview)
info.description: The v2 gateway over SILO's schema `api`: 14 resources, five shared parameters, one envelope and one error object. Generated from supabase/functions/silo-api/registry.ts by scripts/gen_openapi_v2.py; do not edit by hand. Deployed preview. The v2 gateway is live; v1 remains available.

get.description:
Deployed preview. Which funds look odd? Forensic screens: signals, not verdicts.

FIDC delinquency, first vs last observation in BRL and in points of NAV, the move classified (driver). No window before 2025-01.

This playground selects `delinquency_drivers` on `GET /screens`. See the [full resource reference](/api-docs/v2/reference/screens) for all variants.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The page size. More rows than one page come through next_page_url, never cut silently; a call stops at the tier's rows-per-call cap with meta.tier_cap_reached. Default: the tier's page maximum (10 anonymous, 100 signed in); a larger value is coerced to it.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The opaque cursor from a previous next_page_url. It carries every other parameter: send it alone (another parameter with a different value is bad_request). Default: none: the first page.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Hidden parameter (`?help=all` lists it). zombie_growth: the aging month-end (p_period). delinquency_drivers, restatements, late_filers: the window end (p_end). Default: the screen's own: zombie_growth the latest aging month; delinquency_drivers the latest complete FIDC month; restatements today; late_filers the newest month whose deadline has passed.

parameters.name: months
parameters.description: Hidden parameter (`?help=all` lists it). delinquency_drivers (2..24), restatements, late_filers (1..36): the window length in months. Default: the screen's SQL default (12).

parameters.name: min_months
parameters.description: Hidden parameter (`?help=all` lists it). delinquency_drivers: observations a fund needs, 2..months. Default: the SQL default (6).

parameters.name: min_delta_brl
parameters.description: Hidden parameter (`?help=all` lists it). delinquency_drivers: the up/down threshold on delinquency, BRL. Default: the SQL default (1000000).

parameters.name: min_delta_pp
parameters.description: Hidden parameter (`?help=all` lists it). delinquency_drivers: the up/down threshold on the rate, percentage points. Default: the SQL default (1.0).

parameters.name: driver
parameters.description: Hidden parameter (`?help=all` lists it). delinquency_drivers: keep one class of move (an output filter). Default: all.

default.description: The v2 error object. A SILO refusal (over_limit) keeps its message, hint and details verbatim.

bearerAuth.description: SILO user access token for authenticated data requests.

data.description: Always a list. Rows as the endpoint returned them; null stays null.

request.description: Every parameter the resource takes, with the default applied.

id_known.description: Whether SILO holds the id; null when the call names none.

tier_cap_reached.description: True when the result is partial because of the tier cap.

next_page_url.description: Present only when more rows remain. It carries one opaque cursor.
